summary.text: Joseph Griffo is a Republican state senator who represents New York State Senate District 53 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Griffo, a former mayor of Rome and Oneida County executive, has been a state senator since 2007 and is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Griffo lives in Rome, New York, and earned a B.A. in political science from the State University of New York at Brockport in 1978.
His career experience includes working as an intern for Assemblyman James Hurley, as an administrative assistant to the mayor of Rome, and as director of community relations for the City of Rome.
Griffo was elected three times as mayor of Rome, serving from 1991 to 2002, and was Oneida County executive from 2003 to 2006.
He has served in the State Senate since 2007.
In the 2025-2026 session he is ranking member of the Higher Education Committee and is also assigned to the Rules, Transportation, Cities 2 and Finance committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Griffo faces Mandi Drake (D / Working Families Party).
